title: Workflow to extract and process RNA from Drosophila testes with and without Wolbachia
author: Lore Van Vlaenderen
materials: Cap the tube and store On ice .

Using the forceps in your dominant hand, grasp the testes and transfer them to a Centrifuge tubes, safe-lock, PCR clean, 2 mL Eppendorf Catalog #022363344 containing 800 µL of chilled TRIzol Reagent Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #15596026 and three Homogenizing beads, 2.8 mm, ceramic VWR International (Avantor) Catalog #10158-554 . Placing the tissue directly into the TRIzol will cause it to stick to the forceps. Instead, place the tissue on the side of the tube above the TRIzol and then tilt the tube to immerse the tissue in the TRIzol.
Thoroughly clean the working surface and equipment surfaces with 10 % (v/v) bleach, 70 % (v/v) ethanol, and RNase Free, Surface Decontaminant ApexBio Technology Catalog #10-228 .
Thoroughly clean the working surface and equipment surfaces with RNase Free, Surface Decontaminant ApexBio Technology Catalog #10-228 .
Distribute 3 µL of the DNase mixture into individual Tubes, 0.2 mL, flat cap Thermo Fisher Catalog #AB0620 .
Quality control: Measure RNA abundance using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer and Qubit RNA High Sensitivity (HS) Assay Kit Invitrogen Catalog #Q32855 .

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Decontaminate
steps.instruction: Clean the working surface, stereomicroscope base, and fly pad using 10% (v/v) bleach, 70% (v/v) ethanol, and RNase Free Surface Decontaminant (ApexBio Technology Catalog #10-228).

substeps.instruction: Fill a dissecting dish halfway with 1x PBS and position it under the stereomicroscope optics.
Fold a Kimtech Kimwipe delicate task wipe (Kimberly-Clark Catalog #34155), position it behind the dish, and saturate it with RNase Free Surface Decontaminant (ApexBio Technology Catalog #10-228).

steps.title: Dissect Drosophila Testes
steps.instruction: Extract testes from male flies using a stereomicroscope and fine-tipped forceps.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize males using CO2 and transfer them to a fly pad attached to a CO2 line.
Grasp a fly by the upper abdomen with non-dominant hand forceps and transfer it to the PBS-filled dissecting dish.
Grasp and gently pull the tip of the abdomen with dominant hand forceps to release contents; if testes are not visible, gently squeeze the abdomen from anterior to posterior.
Once testes are visible, transfer the fly to the RNase-Free-saturated Kimwipe.
Remove digestive tissues and other debris using both sets of forceps and transfer them to the Kimwipe.

steps.title: Initial Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Prepare the dissected samples for homogenization and storage.

substeps.instruction: Position an ice bucket to the dominant side of the stereomicroscope.
Transfer samples to a bead-mill homogenizer tube holder chilled to -20 °C.
Homogenize the samples at 1500 rpm for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge the samples at approximately 15000 rpm for 30 seconds to remove contents from the tube lid.
Store samples at -80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: RNA Extraction and Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using chloroform phase separation.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from -80 °C and thaw completely at room temperature.
Centrifuge at approximately 15000 rpm for 30 seconds to clear the lid.
Allow samples to sit for 5 minutes at room temperature to dissociate nucleoprotein complexes.
(Optional) Add 1 µL of Universal RNA Spike I (TATAA Biocenter Catalog #RS25SI) pre-diluted 1:64 to samples.

(Optional) Prepare Spike I control by adding 1 µL pre-diluted Universal RNA Spike I to 24 µL Low EDTA TE (1X), pH 8.0 (Quality Biological Catalog #351-324-721) in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube; keep on ice.
Add 160 µL of Chloroform (99.8+%, ACS grade, Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #032614.K2) to each sample in a chemical hood.
Cap securely and shake vigorously for 15 seconds or until the color is uniform.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes to separate into red phenol-chloroform phase, interphase, and colorless upper aqueous phase.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove 300 µL of the upper aqueous phase using a slow pipette speed (setting 2 on Eppendorf Xplorer p1000) and transfer to a new tube; discard the old tube.
Add 3 µL of Glycogen UltraPure (Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #10814010) to the aqueous phase.
Add 400 µL of Isopropanol (99.5%, molecular biology grade, Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #327272500) and invert 10 times to mix.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g, 4 °C, for 20 minutes.
(Optional) If the pellet is not visible, repeat the centrifugation step to encourage formation.

steps.title: RNA Washing and Recovery
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet and resuspend it.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove all supernatant using a slow pipette speed (setting 2 on Eppendorf Xplorer p1000).
Add 500 µL 75% ethanol to the pellet.
Vortex for 10 seconds.
Centrifuge at 7500 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Remove all supernatant using a slow pipette speed (setting 2 on Eppendorf Xplorer p1000).
Repeat the ethanol wash (add 500 µL 75% ethanol, vortex 10s, centrifuge 7500 x g 5min, remove supernatant) three more times for a total of four washes.
Centrifuge at approximately 3200 x g for 15 seconds and discard remaining liquid by pipetting.
Air-dry the pellet for 10 minutes with the lid open (do not dry completely).
Re-suspend the pellet in 25 µL Low EDTA TE (1X), pH 8.0 (Quality Biological Catalog #351-324-721) by pipetting up and down at slow speed (setting 2 on Eppendorf Xplorer p1000).
Incubate at 60 °C for 10 minutes at 0 rpm using a Thermomixer.

steps.title: Secondary RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of homogenization and purification to refine the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples to a bead-mill homogenizer tube holder chilled to -20 °C.
Homogenize at 1500 rpm for 2 minutes.
Clean the chemical hood working surface with 10% (v/v) bleach, 70% (v/v) ethanol, and RNase Free Surface Decontaminant (ApexBio Technology Catalog #10-228).
Centrifuge at 21000 x g, 4 °C, for 30 minutes.
Remove all supernatant using a slow pipette speed (setting 2 on Eppendorf Xplorer p1000).
Add 500 µL ice-cold 75% ethanol to the pellet.
Vortex for 10 seconds.
Centrifuge at 7500 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Remove all supernatant using a slow pipette speed (setting 2 on Eppendorf Xplorer p1000).
Repeat the ethanol wash (add 500 µL ice-cold 75% ethanol, vortex 10s, centrifuge 7500 x g 5min, remove supernatant) two more times for a total of three washes.
Centrifuge at approximately 3200 x g for 15 seconds in a mini centrifuge and discard remaining liquid by pipetting.
Air-dry the pellet for 10 minutes with the lid open.
Re-suspend the pellet in 25 µL Low EDTA TE (1X), pH 8.0 (Quality Biological Catalog #351-324-721) by pipetting up and down at slow speed (setting 2 on Eppendorf Xplorer p1000).
Incubate at 60 °C for 10 minutes at 0 rpm using a Thermomixer.

steps.title: RNA Quality Control
steps.instruction: Assess the purity and concentration of the extracted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Use a NanoDrop Spectrophotometer to measure nucleotide concentration (A260), protein contamination (A280/A260), and chemical contamination (A230/A260).
Check the spectral curve for a peak at A270 to ensure no TRIzol contamination.

steps.title: DNA Removal (TURBO DNase Treatment)
steps.instruction: Remove genomic DNA from the RNA samples using the TURBO DNA-free™ Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM1907).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix containing 2 µL TURBO DNase buffer and 1 µL TURBO DNase per sample; mix by flicking and centrifuge at 3200 x g for 2 seconds.
Add 20 µL RNA to each reaction, mix by flicking, and centrifuge at 3200 x g for 2 seconds.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes in a thermocycler.
Add 2 µL inactivation reagent to each tube.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature (or 25 °C on a heat block if room temp < 22 °C), vigorously flicking the tubes 2-3 times during incubation.
Centrifuge at 10000 x g for 1 minute 30 seconds to pellet the inactivation reagent.
Transfer 20 µL of supernatant to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube (Catalog #022363212), avoiding the white precipitate.

steps.title: DNase Treatment Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify the removal of DNA via PCR.

substeps.instruction: Perform a PCR reaction for 28s using the DNase-treated sample and run a gel.
Ensure no amplification of the host target; use extracted DNA as a positive control and water as a no-template control.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Reverse transcribe the purified RNA into cDNA.

substeps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL flat cap tube (Thermo Fisher Catalog #AB0620), add 4 µL SuperScript IV VILO Master Mix (Invitrogen Catalog #11756050), 1 µL to 16 µL of RNA (max 2500 ng), and water to reach a final volume of 20 µL.
Mix by flicking and centrifuge the solution at 3200 x g for 2 seconds.
Run the following thermocycler program: Anneal primers at 25 °C for 10 minutes; Reverse transcribe at 50 °C for 10 minutes; Inactivate enzyme at 85 °C for 5 minutes; Hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: cDNA Storage
steps.instruction: Store the resulting cDNA based on the intended timeframe of use.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4 °C for use within a few days.
Store at -20 °C for use within a few weeks.
Store at -80 °C for long-term storage.

steps.title: Additional DNA Removal (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform additional DNase treatment if required.

substeps.instruction: Add an additional 1 µL of TURBO DNase to each sample.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes in a thermocycler, then hold at 4 °C.
